violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Box of apples was found on the floor in the kitchen. Food items should be stored at least 6 inches off of the ground.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of the cupboards in breakfast area were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. Handwashing sink in the breakfast serving area was found out of order. Handwashing sinks should be maintained in working condition.

Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Certified food manager left this establishment more than 90 days ago. All food establishments should have a certified food manager available. Establishment should have someone on staff certified as soon as possible.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Handwashing sink in the breakfast serving area was found out of order. Handwashing sinks should be maintained operational.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
